purpose: Strict machine-readable overnight mission contract that freezes one primary-system mission, one packet-at-a-time mutation WIP, bounded recovery/research, evaluator acceptance and reserve activation rules.
status_rule: Only FROZEN contracts are executable. Draft or partially populated prose is never an overnight mutation grant.

wip_rule.meaning: Exactly one primary system mission and one mutation-capable packet at a time. Parallel validation/evidence/recovery may occur only for the same admitted packet/mission.

packet_queue_rules: approved_packet_queue contains every packet exactly once and defines deterministic execution priority.
Every predecessor reference points to a known packet that appears earlier in approved_packet_queue.
Pass-successor and block-fallback references point to known later packets and never to self.
No packet may silently change system, objective, module/capability boundary or authority class.
A completed or blocked packet does not authorize generic work outside its listed successor/fallback rules.

research_policy.none_rule: When mode=NONE every packet must have research_allowed=false and all packet research detail fields must be empty/null.
research_policy.mission_explicit_rule: When the mission itself is research, a bounded mission question, allowed sources/surfaces and stop condition are mandatory.
research_policy.blocking_uncertainty_rule: When bounded research is allowed only to unblock execution, each research-enabled packet must name the blocking question, bounded sources/surfaces and stop condition. Discovery of unrelated research is recorded for later planning and is not executable.

invariants: primary_system and reserve_system_or_null differ when reserve is present.
control_head_at_freeze is an exact hexadecimal Git object id.
definition_of_done, required tests/evaluations and required evidence are non-empty.
Allowed mutation surfaces are bounded; universal '*' or '**' scope is forbidden.
Worker self-acceptance and self-authorized scope expansion are forbidden.
Evaluator acceptance is required before a packet is terminally accepted.
Heartbeats prove liveness only; durable checkpoints prove progress.
Reserve activation requires verified primary exhaustion, not inconvenience or transient failure.
The contract grants no A-01, human, author, private, native, publication or production authority beyond authority already separately admitted.
